name: Wings
description: '''Wings''' is a [[Malaysia]]n ''[[rock kapak]]'' band formed in 1985 in [[Kuala Lumpur]]. They are known for heavy rock vocals and commercially successful singles including "Taman Rashidah Utama", "Biarkan Berlalu", "Misteri Mimpi Syakila", "Sejati", "Di Ambang Wati" and "Semalam Yang Hangat".
